t: The Manrose CSF100T 4" axial bathroom extractor fan provides efficient ventilation for domestic settings. Featuring a robust ABS plastic construction and a flat-fronted design, this low noise fan operates at just 16dBA at 3m, making it ideal for bathrooms and toilets where quiet operation is essential. A performance-enhancing turning vane system in the spigot ensures high output and an extraction rate of 75m³/hr, effectively removing moisture and odours. Installation is flexible as the unit can be wall or panel-mounted and includes a convenient adjustable overrun timer up to 20 minutes.
